title: Malicious code in ferretqueue (PyPI)
description: The ferretqueue package on PyPI version 0.1.0 is part of a malicious campaign involving loader packages that execute code from remote URLs. These packages do not contain the malicious payload themselves but serve as a mechanism to download and run malicious scripts. The campaign is coordinated and aims to provide multiple deceptive methods to load malicious code remotely.
aiSummary: This threat involves the ferretqueue package (version 0.1.0) on PyPI, identified as part of a broader campaign named '2026-10-voice-synthesis-profiles'. The package acts as a loader that downloads and executes remote malicious scripts. While the package itself does not contain the payload, its functionality facilitates the execution of malicious code from external sources. This behavior is indicative of a coordinated effort to distribute malware via multiple deceptive loader packages.
aiImpact: The impact of this threat is the potential execution of arbitrary malicious code on systems that install and run the ferretqueue package version 0.1.0. This can lead to compromise of the affected systems, data theft, or further malware deployment. Since the package downloads and executes remote scripts, it can be used to bypass traditional static detection methods.
